database bookstore_db
  provider: postgres
  opt go_module = example.com/test/gen
  opt stores = true

  schema bookstore
    table writers (model Author, node bookstore.v1.Author)
      pk: id
      column id           type=uuid       pk notnull generated=uuid
      column name         type=string     notnull unique
      column full_name    type=string     notnull
      column email        type=string     optional unique
      hasmany Book via author
    table books (model Book, node bookstore.v1.Book)
      pk: id
      column id           type=ulid       pk notnull generated=ulid
      column name         type=string     notnull unique
      column title        type=string     notnull index
      column author       type=uuid       notnull fk->Author
      column genre        type=enum       optional
      column page_count   type=int32      optional
      column created_at   type=timestamp  notnull autocreate
      column updated_at   type=timestamp  notnull autoupdate
      fk author -> bookstore.writers.id on_delete=CASCADE on_update=RESTRICT
      index idx_book_title_genre [title genre]
      index idx_books_author [author]
    table branches (model BookstoreBranch, node bookstore.v1.BookstoreBranch)
      pk: id
      column id           type=ulid       pk notnull generated=ulid
      column name         type=string     notnull unique
      column address      type=string     notnull
    enum Genre [FICTION NONFICTION]
